title: Concrete Copilot reduces cement emissions
description: Concrete Copilot uses AI to help producers design concrete that meets strength requirements with less cement. In January 2024, Concrete.ai reported that its optimized mixes had been used in over 2 million cubic yards of concrete. Average carbon emissions fell by 30% and material costs by $5.04 per cubic yard. In May 2026, Prairie Materials reported that multiple AI optimized mixes had been approved for infrastructure projects.
